results.q: What is the difference between moral responsibility and legal resnposibility. Give example.
results.answer: Moral responsibility tends to be shared among many individuals, whereas causal, role, and legal responsibilities tend to be exclusive [1]. Legal responsibility involves being charged with a crime or liable for damages in a civil lawsuit, such as a physician being sued for malpractice or a manufacturer being found liable under strict liability even if they did nothing wrong [2]. An example of moral responsibility is when a software tester is held responsible for harms caused by outages even if the service outages were not intended, or when a hacker is morally responsible for attempting to invade user privacy even if their program fails to work [3]. An example of legal responsibility is that in the Therac-25 case, AECL could have been sued for damages [4].
